Subject: Draft MAP & security gating strawman — Clearview Bank

Hi Sam / team,

Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MPA) and a short security summary to kick off the evaluation gating conversation. High-level proposal below — aiming for a mutual close window ~6 weeks from now if evidence and DPA can be agreed.

1) MAP phases (proposed)
- Discovery (1 week): PoC scope, sample data, integration endpoints
- Eval (2–3 weeks): functional testing + performance snapshots (hosted vs. private)
- Security gating (parallel): SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ answers, DPA redline + retention alignment
- Close & procurement: DocuSign + purchase order

2) Security acceptance criteria (strawman)
- SOC 2: Type II report or SOC 2 bridge letter where Type II pending; available under NDA within 3 business days of request
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed matrix + supporting artifacts (crypto, logging, incident response) within 5 business days of questionnaire
- DPA: Redwood proposed annex with EU residency option; propose standard retention tiers (logs: 90 days by default; customer data: 365 days) — open to bank-specific carveouts

3) Evidence we anticipate you will request (so we can pre-stage):
- SOC 2 report (pdf)
- CAIQ/SIG matrix (spreadsheet)
- Key rotation/KMS diagram and HSM/KMS vendor details
- Data deletion runbook and archival policy

Ask: Can you confirm (a) whether 90d log retention is acceptable as a starting point, (b) any firm constraints from procurement on DPA language or escrow, and (c) your preferred review cadence for the SIG?

I've attached MPA-draft_v1.pdf and a one-page SOC2-summary.pdf. If the bank wants different retention tiers (30/90/365) we can make that a selectable clause in the DPA. Proposed target sign date: 2026-06-30 to align with your quarter close.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow afternoon if useful.

Best,
Jonas

From: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@clearviewbank.com>

Date: 2026-05-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & security gating strawman — Clearview Bank

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan and attachments. A few quick notes from our side: we like the proposed cadence and target, but we have some firm constraints to flag up front so we can avoid churn on the DPA later.

- Data retention: Bank policy generally expects 90 days for operational logs and 7 years for regulatory PII retention in some workflows. We are willing to accept a 365-day default for customer-derived datasets if we can carve out certain regulated PII to longer retention (up to 7 years) in the DPA annex.
- SOC 2: need the full Type II report if available; if not, a bridge letter + evidence packages are OK as an interim step. SOC report will be reviewed by our InfoSec.
- SIG/CAIQ: please share the completed CAIQ matrix and confirm who on your side will be the SME for the controls (e.g., KMS, encryption at rest/in transit).

Procurement is looping in our PO team for DocuSign/PO timing — I'll introduce Lisa from procurement in the next reply.

Can you also send a brief list of the exact artifacts you can provide immediately (by Friday) so our security team can kick off intake?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Reynolds
Director, IT Risk & Security
Clearview Bank
sam.reynolds@clearviewbank.com
